context.transcript:
Murat, thanks for meeting with me. I was hoping to
get your feedback on the new packaging for our tea
biscuits.
Hi, Ayaka. I really like the look of the new box. But
I have one concern. Will it keep the biscuits fresh
longer?
Yes. Our product testing team will send me their report
soon. We expect the new packaging will improve
product shelf life by at least five days.
Great! Hopefully you'll receive it before our meeting
with investors next week. They'll want to have that
information before committing to continuing their
support.
context.transcript_translation:
穆拉特，谢谢你来和我见面。我想听听你对我们茶点饼干新包装的意见。
你好，绫香。我很喜欢新盒子的外观，但有一点担心：它能让饼干保鲜更久吗？
能。我们的产品测试团队很快会把报告发给我。我们预计新包装至少能把产品的保质期延长五天。
太好了！希望你能在我们下周与投资者开会前收到报告。他们在决定是否继续提供支持之前，会希望先了解这些信息。
context.content_translation: 本段听力围绕“食品包装”展开。请先听清人物关系和对话目的，再抓取时间、地点、原因、行动等关键信息。
